PROJECT(Volume_plot)

ADD_PLOT_CODE_GEN_TARGETS(Volume)


if(ICET_FOUND)
    # If we have Ice-T then add -DHAVE_ICET to the compilation flags.
    # We need to link with OpenGL on Mac when we have IceT.
    if(APPLE)
        set(ICET_OPENGL ${OPENGL_gl_LIBRARY})
    endif()
    # Link icet libraries using absolute pathes
    set(ICET_FULLPATH_LIB ${ICET_OPENGL})
    foreach(X ${ICET_LIB})
        list(APPEND ICET_FULLPATH_LIB "${ICET_LIBRARY_DIR}/${X}")
    endforeach()
    # Other setups
    include_directories(${ICET_INCLUDE_DIR})
    link_directories(${ICET_LIBRARY_DIR})
    add_definitions(-DHAVE_ICET)
endif()

SET(COMMON_SOURCES
VolumePluginInfo.C
VolumeCommonPluginInfo.C
VolumeAttributes.C
)

SET(LIBI_SOURCES
VolumePluginInfo.C
)

SET(LIBG_SOURCES
VolumeGUIPluginInfo.C
QvisVolumePlotWindow.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
)

SET(LIBV_SOURCES
VolumeViewerEnginePluginInfo.C
VolumeViewerPluginInfo.C
avtVolumePlot.C
avtVolumeRenderer.C
avtVolumeFilter.C
avtLowerResolutionVolumeFilter.C
avtVisItVTKRenderer.C
avtVisItVTKRenderFilter.C
avtICETCompositor.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
)

SET(LIBE_SOURCES
VolumeViewerEnginePluginInfo.C
VolumeEnginePluginInfo.C
avtVolumePlot.C
avtVolumeRenderer.C
avtVolumeFilter.C
avtLowerResolutionVolumeFilter.C
avtVisItVTKRenderer.C
avtVisItVTKRenderFilter.C
avtICETCompositor.C
avtVolumeResampleFilter.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
)


INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(
${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
${VISIT_PLOT_INCLUDES}
${VISIT_INCLUDE_DIR}/avt/Expressions/Abstract
${VISIT_INCLUDE_DIR}/avt/Expressions/General
)

if(VISIT_SLIVR)
    add_compile_definitions(VISIT_SLIVR)
endif()

LINK_DIRECTORIES(${VISIT_LIBRARY_DIR} )

ADD_LIBRARY(IVolumePlot ${LIBI_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(IVolumePlot visitcommon)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS IVolumePlot)

IF(NOT VISIT_SERVER_COMPONENTS_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)
    ADD_LIBRARY(GVolumePlot ${LIBG_SOURCES})
    set_target_properties(GVolumePlot PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(GVolumePlot visitcommon gui )

    ADD_LIBRARY(VVolumePlot ${LIBV_SOURCES})
    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(VVolumePlot VIEWER)
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(VVolumePlot visitcommon viewer VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2 )
    if(TARGET VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
        target_link_libraries(VVolumePlot  VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
    endif()


    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} GVolumePlot VVolumePlot)

    IF(VISIT_PYTHON_SCRIPTING)
        SET(LIBS_SOURCES
            VolumeScriptingPluginInfo.C
            PyVolumeAttributes.C
            ${COMMON_SOURCES}
        )
        ADD_LIBRARY(SVolumePlot ${LIBS_SOURCES})
        TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(SVolumePlot visitcommon visitpy ${PYTHON_LIBRARY})
        SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} SVolumePlot)
    ENDIF(VISIT_PYTHON_SCRIPTING)

    IF(VISIT_JAVA)
        FILE(COPY VolumeAttributes.java DESTINATION ${JavaClient_BINARY_DIR}/src/plots)
        ADD_CUSTOM_TARGET(JavaVolume ALL ${Java_JAVAC_EXECUTABLE} ${VISIT_Java_FLAGS} -d ${JavaClient_BINARY_DIR} -classpath ${JavaClient_BINARY_DIR} -sourcepath ${JavaClient_BINARY_DIR} VolumeAttributes.java
            DEPENDS JavaClient
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    ENDIF(VISIT_JAVA)
ENDIF(NOT VISIT_SERVER_COMPONENTS_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)

ADD_LIBRARY(EVolumePlot_ser ${LIBE_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EVolumePlot_ser visitcommon avtpipeline_ser avtplotter_ser avtexpressions_ser avtfilters_ser VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2 )
if(TARGET VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
    target_link_libraries(EVolumePlot_ser  VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
endif()

ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EVolumePlot_ser ENGINE)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EVolumePlot_ser)

IF(VISIT_PARALLEL)
    ADD_PARALLEL_LIBRARY(EVolumePlot_par ${LIBE_SOURCES})
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EVolumePlot_par visitcommon avtpipeline_par avtplotter_par avtexpressions_par avtfilters_par VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2 )
    if(TARGET VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
        target_link_libraries(EVolumePlot_par  VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
    endif()

    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EVolumePlot_par ENGINE)
    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EVolumePlot_par)
ENDIF(VISIT_PARALLEL)


if(HAVE_ANARI)
    target_sources(GVolumePlot PUBLIC
        anari/AnariVolumeWidget.C)
    target_include_directories(GVolumePlot PUBLIC anari)
endif()

set(vtkmods VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2)
if(TARGET VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
    list(APPEND vtkmods VTK::RenderingRayTracing)
endif()
vtk_module_autoinit(TARGETS VVolumePlot EVolumePlot_ser MODULES ${vtkmods})

if(PARALLEL)
    vtk_module_autoinit(TARGETS EVolumePlot_par MODULES ${vtkmods})
endif()
